text:
The ring never oscillated: 29 mV swing and no frequency. Only the NMOS side was starved, so the strong un-starved PMOS sits in triode at the DC point. That drops per-stage loop gain below 1, so the ring stays at its static bias point.

The fix is a classic current-starved ring with both sides starved. The NMOS starving devices take their gate from vctrl. The PMOS starving devices are mirrored from a vctrl-driven reference branch through a pb diode.

A two-inverter buffer gives a fast edge at b1. A feed-forward cap from b1 to vout then gives the edge overshoot needed for the ≥1.82 V swing spec. The first-order budget for 290 MHz needs only about 8 µA per stage, so the 150 µW limit leaves ample room.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Ring did not oscillate: only NMOS starved, so un-starved PMOS sits in triode and loop gain <1. Switch to a symmetric current-starved ring (PMOS mirror from vctrl reference). Add a 2-inverter buffer with feed-forward cap for edge overshoot to meet the >VDD swing spec."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I_mid":  (14e-6, 4e-6, 40e-6),    # starving current per stage at vctrl = mid
    "Ls":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),        # starving / mirror device length
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 5.0, 16.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Wn":     (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),        # ring switch NMOS W (L=0.15)
    "Wp":     (1.2, 0.42, 4.0),        # ring switch PMOS W (L=0.15)
    "Wb1":    (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),        # buffer stage-1 NMOS W (PMOS = 2x)
    "Wb2":    (0.8, 0.42, 4.0),        # buffer stage-2 NMOS W (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cff":    (12e-15, 2e-15, 60e-15), # feed-forward cap b1 -> vout (edge overshoot)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    CL = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    N = 3
    L0 = 0.15
    Ls = p["Ls"]

    # PMOS mirror diode carries I_mid at mid control voltage
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Ls, p["I_mid"], vds=0.6)
    vsg = mpd.vgs
    # NMOS reference / starving devices: sink I_mid at vctrl = vmid
    ref = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ls, vmid, VDD - vsg)
    Ws = max(0.42, min(100.0, p["I_mid"] / max(ref["Id"], 1e-12)))
    I_of = lambda v: lut.op("n", Ws, Ls, v, max(0.2, VDD - vsg))["Id"]
    I_lo, I_md, I_hi = I_of(vlo), I_of(vmid), I_of(vhi)

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # bias branch: vctrl -> NMOS -> PMOS diode (pb)
    n.M("MC", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Ws, Ls)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)

    nodes = [f"r{i}" for i in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i]
        y = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"t{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, f"t{i}", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], L0)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, f"s{i}", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn"], L0)
        n.M(f"MS{i}", f"s{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Ws, Ls)

    # buffer: inv1 (sharpen) -> inv2 (drive) with feed-forward overshoot cap
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * p["Wb1"], L0)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb1"], L0)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * p["Wb2"], L0)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb2"], L0)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # ---- first-order performance model ----
    cg = lambda d, W: lut.op(d, W, L0, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    Cg_inv = cg("n", p["Wn"]) + cg("p", p["Wp"])
    Cnode = 1.7 * Cg_inv + 1.5e-15
    Cb1 = cg("n", p["Wb1"]) + cg("p", 2 * p["Wb1"])
    Cavg = Cnode + Cb1 / N

    def f_of(I):
        td = 0.5 * Cavg * VDD / max(I, 1e-12)
        return 1.0 / (2 * N * td)

    f_lo, f_md, f_hi = f_of(I_lo), f_of(I_md), f_of(I_hi)
    Cb2 = cg("n", p["Wb2"]) + cg("p", 2 * p["Wb2"])
    Csw_buf = Cb1 + Cb2 + p["Cff"] + CL
    power = VDD * (I_md + I_md) + 1.4 * Csw_buf * VDD**2 * f_md

    Cout = CL + p["Cff"] + 0.5 * Cb2
    swing = VDD + 0.3 * VDD * p["Cff"] / Cout

    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_md, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": swing, "power": power}
```
